┌─ Recruit's role ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Your recruit of the Watch, from Captain Rhosyn Hartley                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ “Captain Hartley of the Thornwick Watch. We hold the walls; the Downs are another matter.”                                               │
│ “Wolves and bandits on the near roads, goblins farther out. Go carefully until you are seasoned.”                                        │
│ “There is a larger task for those the Watch can trust. Prove yourself first, and come and see me.”                                       │
│ “Show me what you can do out in the Downs and I will give you a recruit of the Watch to fight beside you.”                               │
│ “Once the Watch has vouched for you, tell me what the recruit should be: a shield, a medic, a blade or a spellcaster. You may change your│
│ mind here whenever you like.”                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ > 1  tank                                                                                                                                │
│   2  healer                                                                                                                              │
│   3  melee                                                                                                                               │
│   4  caster                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Number keys or Up / Down choose, Enter sends it. Esc goes back.                                                                          │
